thread:
incident-bot: Pager: high error rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2 — decreased throughput, 502s. Paging sam-oncall and maria-sre. Please acknowledge and join bridge.
sam-oncall: Acked. Joining bridge now. Starting mitigation checklist.
maria-sre: On the bridge. I see a spike in model backend queue length, some nodes show OOM in logs. Pushing short-term rollback to a smaller model variant.
leo-platform: Deploy bot: promoted model:v2 -> model:v1-small (canary) to us-west-2 (cmd: /deploy promote --from model:v2 --to model:v1-small --region us-west-2). Canary looks healthy so far.
sam-oncall: Canary shows lower latency, error rate falling from 8% -> 0.9%. I'll keep canary for 20m then lift traffic back gradually. Notifying support for customer-impact calc.
anita-pm: Can we get quick impact numbers? Which customers saw errors and for how long? Need to draft initial customer note.
maria-sre: Quick counts: ~230 unique API keys affected, tail customers with >5% error for ~18 minutes (1726-1744 UTC). Total failed requests ~14.7k. Most impacted were low-throughput enterprise tenants behind dedicated pool A.
leo-platform: Captured logs and leaderboards to /logs/incidents/1735556677/*. Collected heapdumps from 3 nodes, KV cache metrics snapshot, and the canary rollout history.
sam-oncall: Ok. Wrapping up mitigation. Will hand off to post-incident writeup owners. Action items: 1) evidence bundle (logs+dumps+metrics) -> owner: leo-platform 2) timeline draft -> owner: sam-oncall 3) contributing factors analysis -> owner: maria-sre 4) customer impact summary -> owner: anita-pm 5) remediation checklist -> owner: leo-platform 6) postmortem meeting scheduling -> owner: anita-pm
anita-pm: I'll schedule a 60m postmortem 24-48h out. Preferred reviewers: jess-reviewer (ops), maria-sre, sam-oncall, leo-platform. Also cc legal-bot for any PII/data concerns.
jess-reviewer: Happy to review. Please flag any suspected config/rollout drift. I'll focus on timeline and preventative actions. :thumbsup!
leo-platform: Evidence bundle path and short index uploaded. Also created a short reproduction script and sample requests in gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abcd1234
sam-oncall: Draft timeline started in the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/pm/1735556677-timeline (will add timestamps and decision notes). Please add quick notes where you were on the bridge.
maria-sre: Adding contributing factors now: 1) autoscaler mis-specified memory headroom, 2) kernel version mismatch on 2 nodes, 3) a simultaneous model variant rollout increased memory pressure. Drafting a short mitigation suggestion: tighter preflight checks & rollout guardrails.
anita-pm: Customer impact draft: estimate 14k failed requests, 230 keys, 12 customers with visible UI impact (esp. partner-x). I'll start a customer note template; legal-bot, please confirm wording for SLA-sensitive tenants.
legal-bot: Reviewed. For SLA tenants, include exact windows and a proposed credit calculation. No customer PII in attachments; redact tenant IDs in public doc. Recommend legal review prior to external comms.
jess-reviewer: Quick question — do we have a clear owner for a fix to the autoscaler rule? Should that be an SRE epic? I can file the ticket once we decide priority.
leo-platform: I'll open infra ticket INFRA-4721 for autoscaler rule and kernel upgrade playbook; target: 2-week remediation. Tagging maria-sre and sam-oncall.
sam-oncall: Action owners confirmed. Please add estimated ETA and acceptance criteria in the action tracker.
anita-pm: Scheduling note: postmortem invite set for tomorrow 15:00 UTC. Agenda: timeline walkthrough (15m), contributing factors (20m), remediation/owners (20m), external comms plan (5m).
maria-sre: Added notes and a short eval snippet to catch future regressions: unit test for memory headroom check + rollout simulation. Putting PR draft in repo: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/998
jess-reviewer: I'll do a peer review of the draft writeup by EOD tomorrow. Leave a final sign-off comment thread in the doc when done.
sam-oncall: After review and sign-off, we'll mark postmortem status: "ready for leadership review" and then close the incident. Any objections?
anita-pm: No objections. Also capture follow-ups in the action tracker and sync with Customer Success for outreach.
leo-platform: Uploaded final evidence zip and trimmed logs for external sharing (redacted). Link in doc.
sam-oncall: Thanks all. Closing out bridge. Will update thread with link to final postmortem when ready. :white_check_mark:
